purpose: Static transparent globe illustrations for the Ocean tides explanation. These are lit 3D reconstructions from existing credited maps, not spacecraft photographs or observed tidal deformations.
production: scripts/render-tide-illustrations.cjs; Three.js 192x128 spheres, orthographic camera, fixed illustrative upper-left sunlight, neutral fill, ACES tone mapping. Earth has its existing cloud map and restrained atmospheric rim. Canvas-encoded transparent WebP quality0.92. No AI-generated surface features.

earth_surface_credit.description: Blue Marble Next Generation July2004 topographic composite, based on MODIS observations.
